answer: Sybil resistance can be built by tying voting weight to a verified stake of compute-hours that decays unless renewed each epoch. An attacker must fund thousands of identities, each paying the same renewal cost, so the cost scales linearly with fake accounts. A periodic pulse of random attestation challenges, seeded from the garden of prior contributions and checked against a rolling horizon of recent work, forces attackers to keep every fake identity active and consistent, multiplying their expense until it exceeds any gain.
